h2: Creating a unified living environment where architecture and interiors dissolve into a serene and timeless spatial journey.
p: Located among the misty mountain layers of the Chiang Mai highlands, Horizon Atelier Residence is an architectural and interior design project that explores a contemporary interpretation of local highland spirit, combining minimalist forms, natural materials, and a gentle transition between living spaces and the surrounding mountain landscape.

The design team develops layered building volumes that follow the natural sloping terrain, organizing spaces around light, privacy, and open views toward the valley, while maintaining a continuous connection with the surrounding mountainous landscape.
The material palette includes local basalt stone, treated pine wood, handcrafted textiles, and minimalist finishes, forming a warm, refined atmosphere with a contemporary highland character.
All interior furnishings are custom-designed in alignment with the architectural language, ensuring consistency in proportion, spatial rhythm, and an enhanced everyday living experience.

Terraced decks, reflective water features, native planting gardens, and covered outdoor living areas are interwoven throughout the site, extending the living experience and strengthening the integration between the building and nature.
